warning: Atlas crops are ~60x70 px and do not meet the v1.1 original 1024px standalone-art acceptance gate. These are candidate mappings, not approved assets. Alchemy bottle mapping is deliberately ordinal/unverified. The 20 existing full-size individual originals are tracked separately; the same crop must NEVER be assigned to both material and recipe IDs. Do not treat visually similar ingot icons as proof of independent originals. Potion icons A1/A2/A6 have now been semantically re-assigned by individual color/silhouette rather than ordinal index. All 66 remain unverified by original metadata and are unusable for strict v1.1 original-art approval.
